archive.release: Monster Hunter Portable 2nd G, Japan, FUComplete-family
archive.release_evidence: Closest local ISO match by archive and entry headers. The standalone archive differs from that ISO.

field_notes.mapped_path: Names come from the external FUComplete file map. The binary index contains offsets and optional lengths.
field_notes.indexed_payload_bytes: An exact byte length when provided by the supplemental index. Null means only the allocated sector span is known.
field_notes.archive_base_disc_id: The base release of the container. This field alone does not establish the language or origin of an entry.
field_notes.verified_quest_checksum_region: Identifies the salt that verified the quest checksum. JP means the Japanese checksum variant. Null means unknown or inapplicable.
field_notes.mapped_path_locale_tag: jpn is a tag in the mapped path, not a verification of the text language.
